original_finding: The introductory documentation in DenseClustering.lean incorrectly said that functional calculus was mathematically necessary and that powers did not suffice, contradicting the manuscript's valid pointwise dyadic proof.
resolution_basis: The corrected documentation now distinguishes the retained formal functional-calculus proof from the paper-level dyadic alternative, states that functional calculus is not mathematically necessary, and explains that strong convergence of powers alone is weaker than the common exponential-rate hypothesis. This directly removes the contradiction identified in the native intake report.
limitations: This follow-up checked the preserved original, corrected source, supplied diff, correction metadata, and exact hashes; it did not perform a fresh Lean build.
The intake package remains an incomplete dependency checkout, so the broader reproducibility limitations recorded in the native assessment remain unchanged.
The native intake report, recommendation, and score are historical assessment records and were not modified or reissued here.
This correction review is a model assessment of the bounded source-note change, not a human editorial decision.
